title: Finite angular cylinder covers below the half-area bound
main_claim: The regular tetrahedron K (vertices (±1,0,0), (0,±1,√2)) has A_min=√2. For 0<ε≤1/2000 it has a finite cover by 2⌈2/ε²⌉ cylinders with triangular perpendicular bases whose total area divided by √2 is 1/2 − (13/6000)ε² + O(ε⁴), with remainder at most 2ε⁴. That is strictly below A_min/2, which disproves the half-area conjecture. The affine corollary disproves the directionwise (Bezdek–Khan) 1/2 conjecture for every tetrahedron.
coverage: I read the whole main proof line by line: introduction, construction, coverage and area sections, and the corollary. I skimmed the history section. I did not check the extension sections or appendices (angular extensions, cubic buffer, alternative estimates, scaling). Each item below was checked by re-deriving it. (1) Lemma 2.1: the face area vectors, A(u)=max(H|u_x|,|u_z|)+max(H|u_y|,|u_z|), and the bound (U+V)²≥1. (2) Plane equations for both families, including the signs in the G_i sequence for the second family, and the shared-boundary identity α_j−q_iβ_j=(1−q_i²)/4. (3) The first-crossing sector choice, and that the sector conditions force t0≥0. (4) The radial-budget identity a(1−εxq)+b(1+εyp)=ε²(x²α_j+y²α_k)−εx(β_j−q/2)+εy(β_k−p/2). (5) The rough-angle bounds; the bounds |β−q/2|≤Δ/4 and |α−(1+q²)/4|≤Δ/2; the bound x²α_j+y²α_k≤d(p)+d(q)+3ε/2+Δ/4, using (p²−q²)²≥0; and the final gap 2η−(2+2η)ε−ε²/4 ≥ η−17η²/16 > 0. (6) Area: the intercept triangle area HΔT²/2, the projection factor, f_j'(0)=M_j−A_j/8, the bound |f''|≤59/64 (the Taylor step only needs 59/128, so the stated constant has slack), and the sum-to-integral error Δ/2. (7) The integrals ∫d=1/15 and ∫A=17/30, giving 2η−1/240=−13/6000 at η=1/1000. (8) The final inequality 2ε²<13/6000. Numerical check: using the variable-margin criterion with τ=0.05, η=0.06 and n=800, 4×10⁵ random points in the critical band t∈[0.4,0.6] were all covered. The area sum matched the expansion to within O(τ⁴).
sibling_notes: Siblings in family 100 (finite-cylinder approximation of ruled sets; slope-field perturbations of the two-cylinder cover) both reported no_gap_found. This paper is self-contained and does not depend on them.
